operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case and spaced identifiers: tables 'Sales Team', 'Store Locations', 'Sales Orders'; columns 'Customer Names','Product Name','Sales Team','City Name','Household Income','Median Income','Land Area','Water Area','Time Zone','Sales Channel','Order Quantity','Discount Applied','Unit Price','Unit Cost' — all need double-quoting.

FK child columns are underscore-prefixed (_SalesTeamID,_CustomerID,_StoreID,_ProductID) while parent PKs are not (SalesTeamID,CustomerID,StoreID,ProductID); name-based FK inference would miss them, pragma foreign_key_list is required.
All declared NOT NULL flags are 0 and all null_rate 0.0 — no NULLs in original, but TS will emit NULLs (empty parent, dropout) and sqlite will accept them since no NOT NULL constraint.
Dates stored as TEXT in M/D/YY format ('12/31/17','4/10/18','6/1/18') — declared TEXT so TS dispatches to String, not Date; no %Y-%m-%d template will be inferred.
Unit Price / Unit Cost are TEXT with thousands separators ('1,963.10') — String fuzzer, not Number; numeric comparisons on them are string comparisons.
OrderNumber TEXT PK with format 'SO - 0001000' (spaces around dash) — String fuzzer will not reproduce the pattern; PK uniqueness enforced by drop-PK-duplicates.
Regions.StateCode is TEXT PK with 2-letter codes ('AL','AR'); Store Locations.StateCode FK references it — child draws from parent's final filtered values.
Store Locations has 367 rows but only 45 distinct StateCode values (many-to-one to Regions' 48) — FK fan-in is real, not 1:1.
CurrencyCode has distinct=1 ('USD') — String sampler with one element will mostly return 'USD' plus contamination.
Region columns in Regions and 'Sales Team' both have 4 distinct values (South/West/Northeast/Midwest) but no FK links them — TS will not correlate them.
Latitude/Longitude REAL with negative values (-86.79) — Number fuzzer range [-10^scale,10^scale] with scale from REAL (no args) will produce implausible magnitudes.
AreaCode INTEGER 3-digit (205,256) and Land Area INTEGER ~3e8 — Number fuzzer treats both as generic ints in [-10^scale,10^scale], losing the magnitude distinction.
operator_ts_expectations: All TEXT columns (dates, prices, codes, names, time zones) go to String fuzzer: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings of length 0-20 with 50% contamination — implausible for dates/prices/codes.

All INTEGER/REAL columns go to Number fuzzer: uniform in [-10^scale,10^scale] (scale=0 for INTEGER, scale=4 for REAL) then +-1/+-2 perturbation — Population, Land Area, Latitude all get same magnitude range.

PK columns (CustomerID, ProductID, StateCode, SalesTeamID, StoreID, OrderNumber) get max_l0=inf so fresh draws never reuse — good for uniqueness, but StateCode TEXT PK gets random strings not 2-letter codes.

FK columns (_SalesTeamID etc.) draw from parent's final values with replacement — ties/duplicates in child are expected and correct; parent PK filtering happens before child draw only for self-FK (none here).
String fuzzer on 'Customer Names' etc. will produce random strings, not 'Avon Corp' style — joins on names will still work (same random value drawn) but WHERE name='Avon Corp' will miss.
Date-like TEXT columns get String fuzzer, so ORDER BY ProcuredDate / date comparisons operate on random strings — lexicographic order is meaningless, likely FN on date-range queries.
Number fuzzer on Discount Applied (REAL, 7 distinct 0.05-0.3) will produce values in [-10^4,10^4] — WHERE discount BETWEEN 0.05 AND 0.15 will mostly miss.
Number fuzzer on Order Quantity (INTEGER, 8 distinct 1-8) will produce values in [-1,1] range mostly — WHERE quantity > 5 will mostly miss (FN).
String fuzzer on CurrencyCode (1 distinct) with p=0.2 fresh draws will inject random strings — WHERE CurrencyCode='USD' will miss ~20% of rows (FN).
String fuzzer on Sales Channel (4 distinct) will inject random strings — GROUP BY channel produces many spurious groups (FP on count-distinct queries).
Number fuzzer on AreaCode (177 distinct 3-digit) produces values in [-1,1] — WHERE AreaCode=205 will miss (FN).
Regions.Region and Sales Team.Region both 4 distinct but uncorrelated — TS draws independently, so joins on Region produce cross-product-like results (FP on correlation queries).
